offensiveAbilities.name: Impaling Critical
offensiveAbilities.description: When a titan centipede scores a critical hit with its mandibles, the target is painfully pierced with barbed spines and bristles, taking 1d6 Bleed Damage and becoming Off-Guard as long as the bleed damage continues.

offensiveAbilities.name: Titan Centipede Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d8 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 2, and Slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d10 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 2, and Slowed 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Huge or smaller, foot, Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Undulate
offensiveAbilities.description: The titan centipede Strides up to its Speed or Steps. During this movement, it can pass through spaces as narrow as 10 feet without Squeezing.
